message: Hi, we are building a wallet and are ready to integrate your swap API. Could you send the technical documentation and integration requirements? We want to start implementation this week.
Do you have a JavaScript SDK, or should we integrate directly with the REST API?

Which blockchain networks are currently supported by your API? We are comparing several providers before deciding whether to integrate.
